questions.question: What error code appears when you try to install the VPN client on a personal laptop?

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Policy
top.text: Personal devices may not connect to the VPN. The client checks for a device certificate that is only installed on company-managed laptops. Attempting to install the client on a personal machine will fail at step 3 above with error code 1103.
top.label: 01/Policy

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Troubleshooting > VPN disconnects every few minutes
top.text: This is almost always a protocol issue on home networks. Open the VPN client, go to Settings, then Connection, and switch the protocol from UDP to TCP. Reconnect. If it still drops, restart the laptop once. If the problem continues on a wired connection too, file a ticket and include the time of the last three disconnects.

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Connecting for the first time
top.text:
1. Open the VPN client from the Start menu on Windows or the Applications folder on macOS.
2. Enter the gateway address shown on your onboarding card. Do not use a gateway from another region; it will connect but be slow.
3. Sign in with your work email and password.
4. Approve the push notification on your registered phone. If you do not receive it within 30 seconds, open the authenticator app and use the six-digit code instead.
top.label: 01/Connecting for the first time

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Overview
top.text: The corporate VPN gives employees secure access to internal systems when working outside the office. All laptops issued after January 2025 ship with the VPN client preinstalled. Warehouse staff do not have VPN enabled by default because their tools are available on the local network only; they can request access

top.text:

questions.question: How long is a password valid before it expires?

top.header_path: Password and Account Security > Password rules
top.text: Passwords must be at least 14 characters and contain three of the four categories: uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols. Passwords expire every 180 days. You will receive reminder emails at 14, 7, and 1 day before expiry. A password cannot match any of your previous 12 passwords. Passphrases such as four unrelated words are allowed and encouraged because they are easier to remember and harder to guess than short complex strings.
top.label: 02/Password rules

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Troubleshooting > Authentication loop
top.text: If the client keeps asking for your password after you have entered it correctly, your account may be locked. Use the self-service password portal to unlock it, wait five minutes, then try again.

top.header_path: Password and Account Security > Changing your password > On Windows
top.text:
1. Press Ctrl+Alt+Delete.
2. Choose Change a password.
3. Enter the old password, then the new password twice.
4. Lock and unlock the laptop once so cached credentials refresh. If you skip this step, Outlook and Teams will keep prompting with the old password for up to an hour.

top.header_path: Password and Account Security > Locked account
top.text: An account locks after five failed sign-in attempts within 15 minutes. The lock clears automatically after 30 minutes. If you need access sooner, go to the self-service password portal, choose Unlock account, and enter the one-time code sent to your registered phone. If your registered phone is not available, the helpdesk can unlock your account after verifying your identity with your employee id and manager's name.

top.header_path: Password and Account Security > Phishing
top.text: Never enter your password on a page you reached from an email link. The real sign-in page always shows the company logo and the address ends in example.com. Report suspicious emails with the Report Phishing button in Outlook. Do not forward them. If you did enter your password on a suspicious page, change it immediately using the steps above and inform the security team the same day.

questions.question: I got a new phone and already wiped the old one. How do I get MFA working?

top.header_path: Password and Account Security > Multi-factor authentication
top.text: MFA is mandatory for VPN, email, and all cloud applications. The authenticator app is the preferred method. SMS codes are available as a fallback but are slower and less secure. If you change phones, re-register the authenticator app before you wipe the old device. If you have already wiped it, the helpdesk must reset your MFA, which requires a video call for identity verification and takes about 20 minutes.
top.label: 02/Multi-factor authentication

questions.question: What driver do I pick when adding a printer on Windows?

top.header_path: Printer Setup and Issues > Adding a printer > Windows
top.text:
1. Open Settings, then Bluetooth and devices, then Printers and scanners.
2. Click Add device, wait ten seconds, then click Add manually.
3. Choose Add a printer using an IP address or hostname.
4. Enter the IP address from the label. Leave the port name as suggested.
5. When asked for a driver, choose the generic PCL6 driver. Do not download a manufacturer driver; the generic one is faster and is the only one the print server supports.
6. Print a test page.
top.label: 03/Windows

top.header_path: Printer Setup and Issues > Adding a printer > macOS
top.text:
1. Open System Settings, then Printers and Scanners.
2. Click Add Printer, Scanner, or Fax.
3. Select the IP tab.
4. Enter the IP address. Protocol should be IPP. Leave Queue empty.
5. For Use, pick Generic PostScript Printer.
6. Click Add and print a test page.
top.label: 03/Adding a printer

top.text: Printer Setup and Issues Finding your printer Every office printer has a label on the front with its name and IP address. Printer names follow the pattern SITE-FLOOR-NUMBER, for example AUS-02-03 is the third printer on the second floor in Austin. Always add printers by IP address rather than by name. questions.question: When are OS updates pushed and how long do I have to restart?

top.header_path: Laptop Performance and Updates > Update policy
top.text: Operating system updates are pushed on the second Tuesday of each month. You will see a notification with a seven-day window to restart at a convenient time. After seven days the laptop restarts automatically outside working hours. Security patches rated critical may be pushed outside this schedule with a 24-hour window.
top.label: 04/Update policy

top.header_path: Laptop Performance and Updates > Slow after an update
top.text: After a major update the laptop rebuilds its search index and scans files for the security agent. This takes between 30 and 90 minutes depending on how much data is on the disk, and the laptop will feel sluggish during that period. The fix is patience plus two restarts: restart once immediately after the update finishes, then again an hour later. If the laptop is still slow the following day, file a ticket and include a screenshot of Task Manager or Activity Monitor sorted by CPU.

top.header_path: Laptop Performance and Updates > Fans running constantly
top.text: Usually the security agent or a stuck browser tab. Restart first. If the fans run loud at idle for more than a day after a restart, file a ticket; the fan may be clogged with dust and Facilities can clean it.

top.text:

3. How long since the last full restart. Sleeping the laptop for two weeks is not a restart. Shut it down fully once a week.
4. Whether a backup or sync is running. The cloud drive client shows a progress indicator in the system tray or menu bar.

top.text: Open Teams, go to Settings, then Devices, and check that the correct microphone and speaker are selected. top.text: Folder permissions are managed by the owner team listed in the table, not by IT. Ask the team lead to add you. IT can tell you who the owner is but cannot grant access.

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Troubleshooting > VPN disconnects every few minutes
top.text: This is almost always a protocol issue on home networks. Open the VPN client, go to Settings, then Connection, and switch the protocol from UDP to TCP. Reconnect. If it still drops, restart the laptop once. If the problem continues on a wired connection too, file a ticket and include the time of the last three disconnects.

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Overview
top.text: The VPN uses split tunnelling. Traffic to internal addresses goes through the tunnel; everything else uses your normal internet connection. This is why video calls still work when the VPN is slow, and why you cannot reach shared drives when the VPN is disconnected.

questions.question: What is the Outlook mailbox size limit and when does it warn?

top.header_path: Collaboration Tools: Teams, Outlook, and Shared Drives > Outlook > Mailbox full
top.text: The mailbox limit is 50 GB. Outlook warns at 45 GB. Empty Deleted Items and Junk first, then sort the inbox by size and remove large attachments you no longer need. Archive folders do not count against the limit; move old mail there.
top.label: 05/Mailbox full

top.header_path: Collaboration Tools: Teams, Outlook, and Shared Drives > Outlook > Keeps asking for password
top.text: Close Outlook. On Windows, open Credential Manager, choose Windows Credentials, and remove every entry that starts with MicrosoftOffice. Reopen Outlook and sign in once. On macOS, open Keychain Access and delete the entries for Exchange, then reopen Outlook. If you changed your password recently and skipped the lock-and-unlock step, that is the cause.

top.header_path: Password and Account Security > Phishing
top.text: Never enter your password on a page you reached from an email link. The real sign-in page always shows the company logo and the address ends in example.com. Report suspicious emails with the Report Phishing button in Outlook. Do not forward them. If you did enter your password on a suspicious page, change it immediately using the steps above and inform the security team the same day.

questions.question: How long does a software request take to be approved?

top.header_path: Software Requests and Policy > Requesting software not in the catalogue
top.text:
1. Check the catalogue twice. Many applications are listed under a different name than you expect.
2. File a ticket with the application name, version, vendor website, and a one-paragraph business justification.
3. The request goes to the security team for a licence and risk review. This takes three to five working days for well-known software and up to three weeks for anything new.
top.label: 06/Requesting software not in the catalogue

top.header_path: Software Requests and Policy > Temporary administrator rights
top.text: For installers that genuinely need administrator rights, you can request a 60-minute elevation through the Admin Request tool. Your manager receives an approval prompt. Elevations are logged and audited. Do not use elevation to install software that was rejected in a request; this is a policy violation.

top.header_path: Software Requests and Policy > Open source
top.text: Open source libraries for development are not restricted. Open source desktop applications go through the normal request process, usually on the fast track.

top.header_path: Software Requests and Policy > Installing software
top.text: Standard users cannot install software directly. This is deliberate. Open the Software Center on Windows or Self Service on macOS and search for the application. If it is listed, click Install and it will be set up within a few minutes without needing administrator rights. The catalogue includes browsers, PDF tools, developer tools, and the standard office suite.

top.header_path: Software Requests and Policy > Browser extensions
top.text: Extensions are controlled by an allow list. If an extension is blocked, request it through the same process as software. Ad blockers are allowed. Extensions that read page content on every site, such as grammar checkers, require a security review.

2. Whether the disk is more than 90 percent full. Empty the Downloads folder and the Recycle Bin or Trash.
3. How long since the last full restart. Sleeping the laptop for two weeks is not a restart. Shut it down fully once a week.
4. Whether a backup or sync is running. The cloud drive client shows a progress indicator in the system tray or menu bar.

questions.question: Which VPN gateway has a maintenance window on Sundays?

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Regional gateways
top.text:
| Region | Gateway | Protocol default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Americas | vpn-us.example.com | UDP | Highest capacity |
| Europe | vpn-eu.example.com | UDP | Maintenance window Sundays 02:00 to 04:00 CET |
| India | vpn-in.example.com | TCP | TCP default because of ISP filtering |
| APAC | vpn-apac.example.com | UDP | Serves Taipei and Seoul |
top.label: 01/Regional gateways

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Connecting for the first time
top.text:
1. Open the VPN client from the Start menu on Windows or the Applications folder on macOS.
2. Enter the gateway address shown on your onboarding card. Do not use a gateway from another region; it will connect but be slow.
3. Sign in with your work email and password.
4. Approve the push notification on your registered phone. If you do not receive it within 30 seconds, open the authenticator app and use the six-digit code instead.

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Troubleshooting > VPN disconnects every few minutes
top.text: This is almost always a protocol issue on home networks. Open the VPN client, go to Settings, then Connection, and switch the protocol from UDP to TCP. Reconnect. If it still drops, restart the laptop once. If the problem continues on a wired connection too, file a ticket and include the time of the last three disconnects.

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Overview
top.text: The VPN uses split tunnelling. Traffic to internal addresses goes through the tunnel; everything else uses your normal internet connection. This is why video calls still work when the VPN is slow, and why you cannot reach shared drives when the VPN is disconnected.

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Policy
top.text: Personal devices may not connect to the VPN. The client checks for a device certificate that is only installed on company-managed laptops. Attempting to install the client on a personal machine will fail at step 3 above with error code 1103.

questions.question: Teams shows a black screen instead of my camera. What should I try?

top.header_path: Collaboration Tools: Teams, Outlook, and Shared Drives > Teams > Camera shows a black screen
top.text: Close every other application that could be using the camera, especially browser tabs with video. On Windows, open Settings, Privacy, Camera, and confirm desktop apps are allowed. If the camera works in another app but not Teams, sign out of Teams and sign back in.
top.label: 05/Camera shows a black screen

top.header_path: Collaboration Tools: Teams, Outlook, and Shared Drives > Teams > Audio not working in meetings
top.text: Open Teams, go to Settings, then Devices, and check that the correct microphone and speaker are selected. Headsets sometimes register as two devices; pick the one with "Hands-Free" in the name for calls. On macOS, also open System Settings, Privacy and Security, Microphone, and confirm Teams is allowed. If other people cannot hear you but you can hear them, it is almost always the microphone permission.

top.header_path: Password and Account Security > Changing your password > On Windows
top.text:
1. Press Ctrl+Alt+Delete.
2. Choose Change a password.
3. Enter the old password, then the new password twice.
4. Lock and unlock the laptop once so cached credentials refresh. If you skip this step, Outlook and Teams will keep prompting with the old password for up to an hour.

top.header_path: Laptop Performance and Updates > Fans running constantly
top.text: Usually the security agent or a stuck browser tab. Restart first. If the fans run loud at idle for more than a day after a restart, file a ticket; the fan may be clogged with dust and Facilities can clean it.

top.header_path: Printer Setup and Issues > Common problems > Prints are blank or streaked
top.text: This is a hardware issue. Do not try to fix it yourself. Note the printer name and file a ticket with priority low. Facilities replaces toner and drums on a schedule and will pull it forward if a ticket is open.

questions.question: The VPN says I'm connected but my shared drive still won't open. What now?

top.header_path: VPN Access Guide > Troubleshooting > Connected but cannot reach shared drives
top.text: Confirm the status shows Connected and not Connecting. Then open File Explorer and reconnect the drive. Shared drives are only reachable while the VPN is up or when you are in the office. If the drive letter is missing entirely, see the Shared Drive article.
top.label: 01/Connected but cannot reach shared drives

top.header_path: Collaboration Tools: Teams, Outlook, and Shared Drives > Shared drives > Drive not mapping
top.text:
Shared drives require the VPN when you are outside the office. Connect to the VPN first, then open File Explorer and reconnect the drive. If the drive letter is missing, open File Explorer, right-click This PC, choose Map network drive, and enter the path from the table below. On macOS, use Finder, Go, Connect to Server, and enter the smb path.
| Drive | Windows path | macOS path | Owner team |
|---|---|---|---|

If it still drops, restart the laptop once. If the problem continues on a wired connection too, file a ticket and include the time of the last three disconnects.

top.header_path: Password and Account Security > Changing your password > On macOS
top.text:
1. Open System Settings, then Users and Groups.
2. Click Change Password next to your account.
3. Enter the old and new passwords.
4. Open Keychain Access and update the saved entries for Outlook and the VPN client, otherwise they will keep failing silently.

questions.question: Can I add a grammar checker extension to my browser?

top.header_path: Software Requests and Policy > Browser extensions
top.text: Extensions are controlled by an allow list. If an extension is blocked, request it through the same process as software. Ad blockers are allowed. Extensions that read page content on every site, such as grammar checkers, require a security review.
top.label: 06/Browser extensions

top.header_path: Software Requests and Policy > Open source
top.text: Open source libraries for development are not restricted. Open source desktop applications go through the normal request process, usually on the fast track.

top.header_path: Software Requests and Policy > Installing software
top.text: Standard users cannot install software directly. This is deliberate. Open the Software Center on Windows or Self Service on macOS and search for the application. If it is listed, click Install and it will be set up within a few minutes without needing administrator rights. The catalogue includes browsers, PDF tools, developer tools, and the standard office suite.

top.header_path: Printer Setup and Issues > Printing from a personal device
top.text: Not supported. Email the document to yourself and print from your company laptop.

top.header_path: Software Requests and Policy > Temporary administrator rights
top.text: For installers that genuinely need administrator rights, you can request a 60-minute elevation through the Admin Request tool. Your manager receives an approval prompt. Elevations are logged and audited. Do not use elevation to install software that was rejected in a request; this is a policy violation.
